wetter.kopf.erklaerung: What is in the briefing, what is too much or too little for you and from when you get an alert.
wetter.kopf.fehler: The metrics could not be loaded.
wetter.kopf.fehler_verbindung: The connection to the server was lost. Your settings are saved and will not be lost.
wetter.vorlage.ersetzt_route: Replaces the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels of this trip.
wetter.vorlage.ersetzt_vergleich: Replaces the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels for these locations.
wetter.vorlage.ersetzt_vergleich_ein: Replaces the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels for this location.
wetter.vorlage.verlust.one: Your 1 change from “{alt}” will be lost.
wetter.vorlage.verlust.other: Your {count} changes from “{alt}” will be lost.
wetter.vorlage.bleibt: Delivery, stages and locations stay unchanged.
wetter.alarm_ab.zaehler: {ausloesend} of {ausgewaehlt} metrics trigger an alert. {ohne} cannot trigger one (precursors and display only).
wetter.alarm_ab.keine_alarmfaehig: None of the selected metrics can trigger an alert. Add, for example, wind, gusts or thunderstorms.
wetter.erklaer.normal_oben: Alert when the value rises above {oben} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.normal_unten: Alert when the value falls below {unten} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.normal_beidseitig: Alert when the value rises above {oben} {einheit} or falls below {unten} {einheit} since the last briefing ({stufe}), and on very large jumps. All clear when it goes back.
wetter.erklaer.gewitter: Alert when the thunderstorm level rises to {gewitter_stufe} since the last briefing ({stufe}). All clear when it falls again.
wetter.erklaer.gewitter_nie: With these colours thunderstorms never reach {stufe}, so no alert.
wetter.erklaer.nie: No alert. The colour only appears in the briefing.
wetter.erklaer.vorbote: Only coloured in the briefing. Precursors do not trigger alerts.
wetter.erklaer.anzeige: Display only: no traffic light and no alert. You set raw or simple below for each list.
wetter.erklaer.ohne_grenze: No limit is set for {stufe}, so no alert.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_farbe: This colour does not exist for thunderstorms.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_hoch_gelb: For thunderstorm level ‘high’ only orange or red is possible.
wetter.gewitter.fehler_hoch_schwaecher: ‘high’ must not have a weaker colour than ‘moderate’.
wetter.grenzen.hinweis: Green is everything between “yellow lower” and “yellow upper”. An empty field means: no limit on this side.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_oben: Upper: yellow must be less than orange and orange less than red.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_unten: Lower: red must be less than orange and orange less than yellow.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_kreuz: The lower limit must not be above the upper limit.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_zahl: Please enter a number or leave the field empty.
wetter.grenzen.fehler_ungueltig: This setting is not valid and will not be saved.
wetter.nicht_im_briefing.hinzugefuegt: {metrik} is now in the briefing and ticked in every channel. Under ‘What goes where’ you can deselect it for individual channels.
wetter.gesperrt.grund: Not available in the location comparison and therefore not in the briefing: {metriken}. The comparison does not support these values.
wetter.warnungen.beschreibung: in the briefing and as an alert as soon as they affect your area
wetter.radar.beschreibung: Alert when rain is coming towards {orte} within the next hour
wetter.anpassen.ueber_mitternacht: Crosses midnight and ends the next day.
wetter.dialog.name: Name
wetter.dialog.beschreibung_platzhalter: what the template is meant for
wetter.dialog.hinweis: Saved are the metric selection, traffic-light limits and alert levels. Delivery, stages and locations are not included.
wetter.dialog.name_vergeben: A template ‘{name}’ already exists. Choose a different name.
wetter.dialog.gespeichert: Template ‘{name}’ saved. You find it under ‘Your own’.
wetter.wsw.text_route: One table for everything. Each row is a metric from the selection above. Each column is a place where a metric can appear: the three channels and the 3-day outlook. The outlook only exists for metrics that are also in the email. A tick means: appears there. Here you only deselect. You drag the order once, it applies everywhere. Raw shows the number, Simple a symbol or a word. Where a metric has both forms, you set this per place. The SMS keeps its abbreviations. New metrics are added above via “+”.
wetter.wsw.text_vergleich: One table for everything. Each row is a metric from the selection above. Each column is a place where a metric can appear: the three channels, the hourly view and the 3-day outlook. The hourly view and the outlook only exist for metrics that are also in the email. A tick means: appears there. Here you only deselect. You drag the order once, it applies everywhere. Raw shows the number, Simple a symbol or a word. Where a metric has both forms, you set this per place. The SMS keeps its abbreviations. New metrics are added above via “+”.
wetter.wsw.warnungen.name: Official warnings
wetter.wsw.warnungen.hinweis: always included: first in email and Telegram, last in the SMS
wetter.wsw.sms_passt_nicht.one: The last metric no longer fits in the SMS.
wetter.wsw.sms_passt_nicht.other: The last {count} metrics no longer fit in the SMS.
wetter.wsw.sms_orte_passt_nicht.one: With {orte} locations, the last metric no longer fits in the SMS.
wetter.wsw.sms_orte_passt_nicht.other: With {orte} locations, the last {count} metrics no longer fit in the SMS.
wetter.wsw.sms.hochziehen: Drag up what matters to you in the SMS.
wetter.wsw.legende.amtliche_warnung: official warning: thunderstorm, level high, from 2 pm
wetter.wsw.bloecke.titel: Switch whole blocks on and off
wetter.wsw.bloecke.stundenverlauf_hinwei: Hourly table for each location below the overview, email only.
Hourly table below the overview, email only.
wetter.wsw.bloecke.ausblick_hinweis_rout: Daily values of the next three stages, in email and Telegram. Default: evening briefing only.
wetter.wsw.bloecke.ausblick_hinweis_verg: Daily values of the next three days, in email and Telegram. Default: evening briefing only.
wetter.wsw.bloecke.etappen_hinweis: Distance, elevation gain and walking time per stage, email only
wetter.wsw.bloecke.vortag_hinweis: what has changed since the last briefing, email only
wetter.wsw.bloecke.nacht_hinweis: the night hours at the end of the stage, email only
wetter.wsw.bloecke.nur_ausfuehrlich: Only applies to the detailed email.
wetter.wsw.kanal.email_format_hinweis: Detailed with tables and colours, or compact as plain text for weak connections.
wetter.wsw.kanal.kurzstil_hinweis: Telegram gets the same short text as the SMS, without buttons. Applies to briefing and alerts. The Telegram column then rests and the SMS column applies.
wetter.wsw.kanal.premium_hinweis: Gets the same text as the SMS for now. A separate selection comes later.
wetter.wsw.fehler: The table could not be loaded.
wetter.wsw.leer: The briefing contains no metrics. Add metrics above under “Not in the briefing”.
wetter.wsw.konflikt: The settings were changed elsewhere in the meantime. The table now shows the current state; your last change was not saved.
wetter.wsw.speicherfehler: Saving failed. The table shows the saved state again.
